name: com.cleveradssolutions.adapters.exchange.rendering.views.browser.AdBrowserActivity
description: CAS.AI's Exchange ad adapter opens an advertiser's web page and video in this in-app browser when an ad needs a landing page. Users can navigate the page or open a link in another app.
disableEffect: CAS Exchange ads will not be able to open their in-app landing pages or videos; other app screens continue to work.
